build.buildCommand: pip install -r requirements/prod.txt && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput

deploy.startCommand: export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.prod DJANGO_SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT=False && python manage.py migrate --noinput && gunicorn config.wsgi:application --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --workers ${WEB_CONCURRENCY:-2} --threads ${WEB_THREADS:-4} --worker-class gthread --timeout 30 --graceful-timeout 20 --max-requests 1000 --max-requests-jitter 100 --access-logfile - --error-logfile -
